prompt: How to get an Emirates ID?
actualResponse:
Step-by-Step Guide: How to Get an Emirates ID  The Emirates ID is a mandatory identification card for all UAE citizens and residents. It is essential for accessing government services, opening bank accounts, signing leases, and more. Below is a clear, step-by-step guide to obtaining your Emirates ID:  1. Ensure You Have a Valid UAE Residence Visa   You must have a valid UAE residence visa before applying for an Emirates ID. This is a strict requirement for expatriates1.  2. Gather Required Documents  Typically, you will need:   Original passport  Valid UAE residence visa (visa page/copy)  One passport-sized photo with a white background (required only for children under 15 years old)5.  3. Choose Your Application Method  You can apply for an Emirates ID in one of the following ways:   Online via the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP) website or ICP mobile app12.  Through an accredited typing centre (these are certified centres that help with the application process)134.  4. Complete the Application   Fill out the application form online or at the typing centre.  Submit the required documents.  Pay the application fee (fee varies depending on the validity period and applicant type)13.  5. Biometric Data Collection   After submitting your application, you will be notified (usually via SMS) to visit an ICP service centre.  At the centre, your fingerprints and photograph will be taken for biometric registration13.  6. Track Your Application   You can track the status of your Emirates ID application online through the ICP website or via the typing centre14.  7. Collect Your Emirates ID   Once your application is approved, you will receive an SMS notification.  You can collect your Emirates ID from the designated Emirates Post office, or it may be delivered to your registered address3.  8. Urgent Service (Optional)   If you need your Emirates ID urgently, the ICP offers a ‘Fawri’ service for UAE nationals and GCC nationals residing in the UAE, issuing the card within 24 hours for an additional fee1.  Important Notes   Carry your Emirates ID at all times, as it is a legal requirement1.  If your Emirates ID is lost, stolen, or damaged, you must apply for a replacement as soon as possible14.  Always keep your Emirates ID details updated with the ICP.  References  1: UAE Government Official Portal – Emirates ID Application Process 
2: ICP Official Services Portal 
3: First Abu Dhabi Bank Expat Guide – Emirates ID 
4: Shuraa – Emirates ID Requirements & Process 
5: Amer Centre – Emirates ID Required Documents   If you need more details about any specific step or have questions about special cases (such as newborns or urgent processing), please let me know!    Sources  Ask  Explain
